title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistle to the Romans, translated by John Owen, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Romans, chapter 9. In his Commentary on the Epistle to the Romans, in the John Owen translation, Calvin writes at Romans 9, verse 1: In this chapter he begins to remove the offences which might have diverted the minds of men from Christ: for the Jews, for whom he was appointed according to the covenant of the law, not only rejected him, but regarded him with contempt, and for the most part hated him. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 22.
